item.title: Hello, World
item.description:
I’ve had a website before. A few, actually. They always started ambitious and ended neglected.

This time I’m trying something different: start small, write consistently, let it grow.

I’m a software developer working on portfolio optimisation systems — Python, React, MySQL, and increasingly GPU programming. I’m also a father of four, which means my time is limited and my motivation to use it well is high.

This site will be a mix of:

item.title: About
item.description:
I’m Munatsi — a software developer based near Reading, UK.

I work at AEG building portfolio optimisation systems. Before tech, I spent six years in the Coca-Cola system. Originally from Harare, Zimbabwe.

I’m interested in systems programming, GPU computing, infrastructure, and building tools that solve real problems. Currently learning Zig and getting deeper into low-level programming.

Outside of work, I’m a father of four, a Christian, and I’m trying to be more of a writer and less of a consumer. This site is part of that effort.
